title: mammillaria mutabilis var. xanthotricha
intro:
Mammillaria mutabilis var. xanthotricha, commonly known as the yellow-spined Mexican peyote, is a cactus species known for its vibrant yellow spines and its ability to produce psychoactive compounds.

This plant has been used in traditional medicine for centuries, with potential health benefits including pain relief, reduced inflammation, and improved mental clarity. The therapeutic actions of Mammillaria mutabilis var. xanthotricha include its ability to stimulate the central nervous system, promoting relaxation and reducing anxiety. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, such as peyotine, which are responsible for its psychoactive effects.
